---
title: "Assignment 0 — Before the first laboratory"
---

Complete this short setup before the first computational laboratory. Its purpose
is simply to verify that your personal environment works before class.

## Preparation

Read the five pages under **Getting Started** in order.

Then complete the following checks in your own private workspace repository.

- Your GitHub account is active and its email address has been verified.
- Your repository was created with **Use this template → Create a new repository**.
- Your repository visibility is **Private**.
- Your Codespace opens successfully.
- The first environment initialization reaches `Environment ready.`.
- The Python environment passes:

  ```bash
  python -c "import gemmi, spglib, py3Dmol, quantas, numpy, scipy, pandas, matplotlib; print('Environment OK')"
  ```

- `update-course`, `start-lab`, and the `quantas` command are available.
- You can edit and save `work/SMOKE_TEST.md`.
- You can commit and synchronize that change with GitHub.
- You can see the updated file in your repository on github.com.
- You can stop the Codespace and reopen the same Codespace successfully.

::: {.callout-note}
## No scientific work is required yet

This onboarding task only checks the working environment. The first
mineral-science notebook will be introduced during Laboratory 1.
:::

If any step fails, keep the exact error message and report it before the
laboratory session.
